5.issue_summary: Silent Background Transfer: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
5.evidence: Timber.plant(CrashlyticsTree()) called unconditionally in onCreate() when not in debug mode.
5.recommendation: Add a prominent disclosure dialog on first app launch before initializing Crashlytics.

6.issue_summary: User-Initiated Collection: Disclosure exempt, but must be declared in Play Store form.
6.evidence: MainActivity fetches DigitalCredential containing family_name. CredentialVerifier.ts extracts name and given_name on the server.
6.recommendation: Ensure NAME collection is declared in the Play Store Data Safety form.

8.issue_summary: Silent Background Transfer: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
8.evidence: In CameraPreview.kt, imageAnalysis continuously captures frames every 1.5 seconds and calls viewModel?.sendFrame(base64) which transfers the frames off-device via maveSessionManager.sendEvent without an affirmative prominent disclosure gatekeeper.
8.recommendation: Implement a prominent disclosure dialog before the CameraPreview is initialized, explicitly stating that camera frames are continuously collected and sent to the server for music generation, and require affirmative user consent.
